input.quote: 11.5 Special, Indirect, and Other Losses. EXCEPT (A) FOR FRAUD, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE, (B) FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS UNDER [ARTICLE 9 OR SECTION 5.8], (C) AS PROVIDED UNDER [***] AND (D) TO THE EXTENT ANY SUCH DAMAGES ARE REQUIRED TO BE PAID TO A THIRD PARTY AS PART OF A CLAIM FOR WHICH A PARTY PROVIDES INDEMNIFICATION UNDER THIS ARTICLE 11, NEITHER PARTY NOR ANY OF ITS AFFILIATES SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 11.5 provides a mutual waiver of indirect/consequential damages with sensible carve-outs (fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, confidentiality breach, third-party indemnified damages), but searches for "aggregate liability", "shall not exceed", "limitation of liability" and all "liable" hits return no monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement (Articles 11 and 13 included). Both Parties are therefore exposed to unlimited direct liability, which fails even the fallback (mutual cap of 12 months' fees with carve-outs). This is not a one-sided defect that benefits us — AbbVie's direct exposure is equally uncapped — so we propose the smallest addition that reaches the preferred position: a new Section 11.5.1 imposing a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' payments and USD 1,000,000, with confidentiality, indemnification, fraud/willful misconduct/gross negligence and IP infringement as uncapped Excluded Claims and AbbVie's Article 6 payment obligations excluded from the cap base.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual monetary liability cap with standard uncapped carve-outs to Article 11
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement waives indirect damages but contains no monetary cap, so both Parties are exposed to unlimited direct liability; we have added a mutual cap set at the greater of twelve (12) months' payments and USD 1,000,000. Confidentiality (Article 9/Section 5.8), indemnification, fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and AbbVie's payment obligations are not treated as capped damages.

ops.text: Cap on Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by AbbVie to Harpoon under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its obligations under Article 9 or Section 5.8, its indemnification obligations under this Article 11, its fraud, willful misconduct or gross negligence, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. AbbVie's obligations to make payments under Article 6 shall not be considered damages subject to the foregoing cap.
